info.name: Kompare - Providers
info.description: All seven operations currently in the Providers Swagger group, plus simple login and category-filter examples. Folders: Authentication, User, Admin. Import/select the companion environment; set base_url and an existing verified email/password. Login automatically saves access_token. Public reads require no login; admin writes require a current super_admin or support_admin. All accounts, IDs and responses are illustrative. Category-specific examples and a deliberately invalid-category request are included. Other Swagger sections (Ingestion, KYC, Crypto, Gift Cards, FX, Provider Reviews) have separate APIs outside this collection. Send requests individually. Update/metrics/ingestion requests change state when sent; importing does not send them.

request.description: Queues ingestion and returns HTTP 202 with a job ID; it does not mean provider data has already been fetched. Default example: wise / market_data, include_kyc=false. Requires a provider with an adapter and a running ingestion worker. Wise supports market_data and currencies; Flutterwave/Fincra support market_data; Stanbic/United Capital support market_data and fund_details. KYC is not supported for FX or mutual funds. Job status is available separately under Ingestion at GET /providers/{slug}/ingestion-jobs/{job_id}. Requires a current super_admin or support_admin access token. Use Login with that account first.
